messages:
sophia: Heads-up — just pulled the 2026-03-01 invoice generation batch. Seeing a handful of customers missing GPU compute line items and two invoices with the same invoice_id. @tom @raj can one of you check billing-render logs?

 tom: looking now. which customers?

 sophia: sample: cust_8921, cust_1102 (missing gpu lines). Duplicate invoice_id: `inv_20260301_907` appears twice for different customers.

 raj: that's weird — duplicates normally get deduped. Billing-bot, can you show the last 3 runs for generator v2?

 billing-bot: generator_v2 runs:
 - 2026-03-01T02:00Z status=success id=run_984
 - 2026-03-01T02:15Z status=partial id=run_985 warnings=render_skip_for_missing_usage
 - 2026-03-01T02:45Z status=success id=run_986

 tom: run_985 has "render_skip_for_missing_usage" — looks like an earlier subjob dropped GPU usage rows. pulling CDC logs.

 liam: FYI finance-ops — do not send those two invoices until we reconcile. also we should re-run for affected accounts once fix landed. :warning:

 raj: found an anomaly: a recent schema change in usage_exporter omitted `gpu_hours` when `usage_type=spot`. PR #4310 changed the serializer. tagging eng-runtime.

 sophia: ok next steps: @eng-runtime please triage PR #4310 rollback or patch. @tom please prepare a fix-run plan: re-run generator for run_985 range and create corrected invoices with suffix `-rev1`. finance team: hold collections for cust_8921 and cust_1102. I'll create a short postmortem after fix.

 tom: on it. will post updates here when re-run complete.

 sophia: thanks — appreciate quick turnaround. :heart:
